Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this '''Zygerrian''' was working as a slaver in the [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|Labor Processing Hub]] on [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]].

==Biography==
This [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|enslaver]] worked in the Labor Processing Hub during the time when [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] colonists of [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]], and their leader [[Roshti/Legends|Roshti]] were imprisoned there. This enslaver helped [[Unidentified Zygerrian enslaver 2|another]] when Obi-Wan dared to talk back to that one for punishing Roshi instead of himself, telling him that he doesn't get commands from a enslaved individual. This enslaver used a rod to electrocute Obi-Wan by using his [[Shock collar/Legends|collar]] until Obi-Wan fell to the ground and asked for forgiveness from the other enslaver.
